summary: Post-refactor validation: App.js was split from 1860 lines into 12 modular component files. All 12 requested test flows pass. Login with admin@example.com/admin123 -> Dashboard loads (7 callsigns, 10 QSOs). Language selector visible on Login/Register/ForgotPassword/Dashboard pages and functional (EN<->FR verified via full UI translation). Callsign row -> ContactDetail navigation works and back button returns to dashboard. FAB button opens AddQSOModal with translated labels; close works. Profile page shows all 3 sections: Change Password, Change Email, and Wavelog with 3 action buttons (Test Connection, Sync Now, Import from Wavelog). Admin panel shows users list and stats (users/QSO counts). Logout returns to login. Register and Forgot Password page navigation works. Refactoring successful - no regressions detected.

issues: Wavelog section renders below fold at 1080p viewport; requires scrolling to see the 3 action buttons. Consider a summary/collapsed header for quick access. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: WavelogSection.jsx line 82: `if (loading) return null;` — if /api/wavelog/config ever hangs (no timeout on axios call), the entire section silently disappears with no error state. Consider showing a skeleton or error state instead of null.
config.js axios interceptor + AuthContext work correctly across the split; App.js is now clean at 64 lines.

shared.jsx language dropdown uses a full-screen `fixed inset-0 z-40` backdrop that occasionally intercepts pointer events during rapid interactions (observed once in tests). Not user-facing but flaky for automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor from monolithic App.js -> 12 modules is complete and verified. All data-testid attributes preserved across the split. All 12 test scenarios in the review request pass. Admin password still admin123. Data state: 7 callsigns / 10 QSOs for admin user. FR/EN language toggle works fully. Wavelog section appears only after /api/wavelog/config returns (200 OK observed).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Initial false alarm on Wavelog section was due to test viewport (1080p) not scrolling; section renders correctly below the Change Email block.
